history.title: v1.5 Languages: text, voice and names
history.intro: The game speaks English, Afrikaans and German, with Dutch text, and every name was adjusted for its audience.
bullets: Separate text and voice languages in Settings.
Oupa voiced in English, Afrikaans and German (interim voices).
An "Afrikaans names" switch keeps Dubbelloop, Windbuks and Kettie in any language.

images.caption: A picture that is not on the server yet (shows this caption instead).

history.title: v1.6 Veld art: trees, fruit, far animals and the windmill
history.intro: Every map's trees, bushes, grass and fruit at the quality of the camelthorn, and far animals that look like animals.
bullets: Plants redrawn on every map at the camelthorn quality bar.
Far animals redrawn with true body shapes; they stay sharp through the scope.
The windmill redrawn from your photos: 20 curved sails, several missing, one bent, rust.
A build stamp on every map, the title and the Skietbaan.
feedback: 25 Oct, about 06:50: the windmill needs more detail and should turn with the wind.
About 07:00: the dassie "needs to be increased a lot".
The independent review found five issues, all fixed.
